pages.text: ParCool makes movement feel natural — wall jumps, vaults, slides, rolls, and ledge hangs are available from the moment you spawn. No crafting, no unlocks. Just move.$(br2)It runs alongside Epic Fight and both share the same stamina bar. Parkour and dodging pull from the same pool.

$(bold)Moves:$()$(br)$(bold)Wall Jump:$() Sprint at a wall, jump again on contact$(br)$(bold)Wall Run:$() Sprint at a wall diagonally (hold L-Alt)$(br)$(bold)Vault:$() Sprint into a 1-block obstacle$(br)$(bold)Roll:$() Land from a fall$(br)$(bold)Hang:$() Grab a ledge mid-fall$(br)$(bold)Slide:$() Sprint + Sneak$(br)$(bold)Crawl:$() Sneak under 1-block gaps

$(bold)Stamina cost:$() Wall-runs, flips, and charge jumps are expensive. Basic moves like slides and crawls cost very little. Don't drain your bar on traversal if a fight is coming.$(br2)The $(bold)epic x parcool$() compatibility mod is installed — dodge key conflicts between the two are resolved automatically.
